text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":14882500,"ns":0,"title":"Contra principia negantem non est disputandum","extract":"Contra principia negantem non est disputandum (Latin, alternatively Contra principia negantem disputari non potest and Contra principia negantem disputari nequit; literally, \"Against one who denies the principles, there can be no debate\") is a principle of logic and law: in order to debate reasonably about a disagreement, there must be agreement about the principles or facts by which to judge the arguments.","description":"Latin phrase","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
